title_en: 54th World Study Abroad Fair: Special Pavilion for Study in Australia
summary: This notice announces the 54th World Study Abroad Fair, which includes a special pavilion on studying in Australia. The notice provides only a title. It gives no details on who should attend, dates, location or registration. Students who are interested should contact the department office; the contact details are in the original notice.
steps: Contact the department office for details on the fair, such as dates, location and any registration; the contact details are in the original notice.
translation:
Title: 54th World Study Abroad Fair (제54회 세계유학박람회) – Special Pavilion for Study in Australia (호주유학 특별관)

[The notice contains only a title. No body text, dates, location or registration details were provided. Any image or attachment that may accompany the original notice was not read.]
